note: A sensitive and specific peripheral blood DNA methylation episignature distinguishes MSL2-related syndrome from related epigenetic disorders, aligned with distinct H4K16ac molecular etiology.

evidence.text: Using blood samples from six cohort members, researchers established a sensitive and specific DNA methylation episignature for MSL2-related disorder, highlighting that global H4K16ac levels remain unchanged unlike in MOF (KAT8) and MSL3 variants, conferring a distinct molecular etiology.

source.title: MSL2 variants lead to a neurodevelopmental syndrome with lack of coordination, epilepsy, specific dysmorphisms, and a distinct episignature
source.quote: Our study defines an MSL2-related disorder as an NDD with distinguishable clinical features, a specific blood DNA episignature, and a distinct, MSL2-specific molecular etiology compared to other MSL complex-related disorders.
